content:
maria: uploading phaeton-21b weights to s3://redwood-models/phaeton/21b/v1 (sha256: d3b4f8...) — ready for onboarding. can someone run a quick smoke perf?
jamal: thanks. where's the tokenizer? huggingface or internal? any special tokens?
maria: tokenizer lives in s3://redwood-models/phaeton/21b/tokenizer/ (tokenizer.json + merges.json). note: tokenizer was trained with a leading-bos token added (bos_token="<s>") and we had to patch merges for a couple of rare merges. small snippet: 
```json
{
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "added_tokens": ["<special_p>"],
  "trim_offsets": true
}
```
jamal: ok good to know. last time we had detokenize issues when bos was preserved in output. please make sure the serving code strips a leading bos prior to scoring.
kai: i'll run config validation and a quick smoke bench today. running: `./tools/validate_model.py --model s3://redwood-models/phaeton/21b/v1 --expect sequence_length=2048` — note: model.json must include `kv_cache=true` and `dtype=fp32` for now. if weights are float32 we might try 8-bit later.
sre-bot: perf job queued on bench-node-3 (a100-80G) — job id: perf-1769904321-1
jamal: quick smoke results (1xA100, seq=128, batch=1): p50 token latency ~120ms, p95 ~210ms, tokens/sec ~48. memory ~45GB. baseline expectations for 21B look okay but batching will be necessary for throughput.
maria: thanks — tokenizer detail: we ended up adding a postprocess step to strip leading whitespace sometimes produced by tokenizer when bos is present. patch in pr #412. also weights saved as fp32 sharded (4 shards) — no quant yet.
kai: i'm starting batched runs: batch sizes [1,4,8,16], seq lenses [128,512,1024]. will push raw metrics + flamegraphs to the artifacts bucket: https://artifacts.redwood.com/phaeton/v1/bench/1769904321
devex-anna: heads-up for catalog: please add `model_card.md` + `known_issues.md` entries for phaeton-21b. known_issues should call out tokenizer BOS behavior and that we currently ship fp32 shards only. example catalog snippet: 
```json
{
  "name": "phaeton-21b",
  "versions": ["v1"],
  "hardware": ["a100-80g","a10g"],
  "max_sequence_length": 2048,
  "notes": "Tokenizer inserts <s> as BOS; serving should remove before scoring."
}
```
maria: quick CR ping @jamal @kai — PR #412 updates tokenizer mapping and adds a small e2e test. would appreciate a quick review before i merge.
jamal: on it, ETA ~2 hours. also will add a small detokenize test to the repo.
kai: perf run in progress (2xA100). early numbers: batch=4 seq=512 gives ~170 tokens/sec aggregate, p50 token latency ~85ms. pushing artifacts now. will post full table when finished.
sre-bot: perf job complete. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.com/phaeton/v1/bench/1769904321/results.tar.gz — includes logs, flamegraphs, and raw bench outputs.
maria: awesome, thanks all :thumbsup: i'll update the catalog entries after the CR is in and then submit the onboarding checklist. if anyone spots a weird detokenize case ping here.
jamal: noted. i'll merge the detokenize test and follow up if anything breaks.
kai: final note for ops: consider adding a quantized 8-bit run in the optimize pipeline to see cost/latency tradeoffs. i can schedule next week.
maria: sounds good. closing for now — will reopen thread with rollout plan once catalog + CR merged.
